question: Was Tarik Skubal's 2026 as good as 2025 under the hood, or did luck change?
report:
> **Verdict: Mostly luck** · Confidence: High · Injury overlap: Yes

Under the hood, Tarik Skubal was nearly as effective in 2026 as he was during his 2025 campaign. Although his ERA rose from 2.21 to 2.72 [Q7], his core performance metrics barely budged: his expected wOBA (xwOBA) shifted slightly from .258 to .266 (z = 0.4) [Q1, Q11], and his FIP remained stable, moving from 2.45 to 2.51 [Q7]. The uptick in allowed runs was primarily driven by luck and regression to expected metrics rather than a skill collapse, as his actual wOBA went from outperforming his xwOBA (.247 vs. .258) [Q11] to slightly underperforming it (.274 vs. .266) [Q11], accompanied by a modest BABIP increase from .273 to .289 (z = 0.5) [Q1, Q11].

## What changed in the pitches

Skubal altered his pitch mix in 2026, leaning more heavily on his four-seam fastball (up from 29.3% to 38.0% of his pitches) while reducing his changeup (31.4% to 25.6%) and sinker (23.9% to 17.5%) usage [Q4]. Slider usage increased from 12.5% to 13.9%, and curveball usage grew from 2.8% to 5.0% [Q4].

His fastball velocity dropped 0.8 mph, falling from 97.6 mph in 2025 to 96.8 mph in 2026 (z = -5.0) [Q4, Q13]. Sinker velocity also dipped from 97.3 mph to 96.7 mph [Q4]. Fastball movement remained steady (17.0 to 17.1 inches of IVB), though its whiff rate edged down from 28.7% to 26.1% [Q4]. Despite the velocity loss, the four-seamer's xwOBA actually improved from .294 to .276 [Q17, Q18]. Meanwhile, his slider saw an increase in whiff rate from 25.5% to 28.8% [Q4].

## Skill vs. luck

Skubal's underlying strikeout and walk skills remained mostly unchanged. His strikeout rate adjusted from 32.2% in 2025 to 30.0% in 2026 (z = -0.9), while his walk rate remained virtually flat at 4.4% across both seasons (z = -0.1) [Q1]. His overall whiff rate (32.5% to 31.7%, z = -0.5) and average exit velocity allowed (85.8 mph to 85.7 mph, z = -0.1) stayed inside normal season-to-season noise [Q1]. 

The primary statistical shift outside of velocity was a decline in strike zone rate, which dropped from 55.0% to 49.6% (z = -3.9) [Q1, Q12]. Skubal compensated by generating more out-of-zone swings, as his chase rate rose from 35.2% to 36.6% (z = 0.8) [Q1]. Home run suppression held steady, with HR/FB staying at 14.1% in 2025 and 14.3% in 2026 [Q11], while his home runs allowed per batter faced shifted from 2.4% to 2.3% (z = -0.2) [Q1, Q12].

## Health and workload

Skubal missed five starts in 2026 due to injury, throwing 158.7 innings over 26 starts after putting up 195.3 innings across 31 starts in 2025 [Q7]. He spent 43 days on the injured list from May 1 to June 13, 2026, due to loose bodies in his left elbow [Q6].

Mechanical and velocity markers presaged the injury stint. His fastball velocity dropped to a monthly low of 96.5 mph in April 2026 before rebounding to 97.2 mph upon his June return [Q9, Q15]. His release extension shortened by 1.3 inches overall (6.471 ft to 6.362 ft), reaching a low of 6.235 ft in early 2026 [Q15, Q16]. His release point also shifted arm-side by 0.136 ft, peaking at a season-wide arm-side distance of 1.956 ft in April 2026 [Q15, Q16]. Elbow discomfort could explain the temporary drop in extension, release point shift, and pre-IL velocity dip.

## What the data can't tell us

- The database lacks Statcast barrel classification data, so contact quality analysis is limited to hard-hit rate, launch angle, and exit velocity.
- Pitch model summaries like Stuff+ or Location+ are unavailable to measure pitch shape independent of outcome metrics.
- Specific medical findings surrounding the elbow procedure beyond the official IL designation cannot be confirmed.

## Next questions

- Did Skubal's pitch movement or extension return to his 2025 baselines during the final month of 2026?
- How did batter performance against Skubal's changeup change when thrown behind in the count versus ahead?
- Did the wider arm-side release point correlate with any changes in horizontal pitch break across his offspeed offerings?

Q1.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS period
               FROM pitches
               WHERE pitcher = ? AND (game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE OR game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE)),
    long AS (SELECT 'k_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('strikeout','strikeout_double_play')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'bb_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('walk','intent_walk')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'hr_per_bf' AS stat, period, CAST((events = 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'whiff_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_whiff) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE is_swing
        UNION ALL SELECT 'chase_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_chase) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14
        UNION ALL SELECT 'zone_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((in_zone) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'csw_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_csw) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'xwoba' AS stat, period, CAST((CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN
        CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN coalesce(estimated_woba_using_speedangle, woba_value)
             ELSE woba_value END END) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE woba_denom = 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 'woba' AS stat, period, CAST((woba_value) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE woba_denom = 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 'babip' AS stat, period, CAST((babip_value) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run' AND babip_value IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT 'exit_velo' AS stat, period, CAST((launch_speed) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE type = 'X' AND launch_speed IS NOT NULL),
    games AS (SELECT period, game_pk, avg(release_speed) AS v, count(*) AS c FROM p
              WHERE release_speed IS NOT NULL AND pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 669373 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY period, game_pk),
    s AS (SELECT stat, period, avg(v) AS mean, coalesce(var_samp(v), 0) AS variance, count(v) AS n
          FROM long GROUP BY stat, period
          UNION ALL
          
          SELECT 'main_fb_velo', period, sum(v * c) / sum(c), coalesce(var_samp(v), 0), count(*) FROM games GROUP BY period)
    SELECT a.stat, a.mean AS period_a, b.mean AS period_b, b.mean - a.mean AS change, a.n AS n_a, b.n AS n_b,
           round((b.mean - a.mean) / nullif(sqrt(a.variance / a.n + b.variance / b.n), 0), 1) AS z
    FROM s a JOIN s b ON a.stat = b.stat AND a.period = 'A' AND b.period = 'B'
    ORDER BY abs(z) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT season, pitch_type, pitches, round(usage_pct, 3) AS usage_pct,
           round(avg_velo, 1) AS velo, round(avg_spin) AS spin,
           round(avg_pfx_x_in, 1) AS h_break_in, round(avg_pfx_z_in, 1) AS ivb_in,
           round(avg_extension, 2) AS extension_ft, round(avg_arm_angle, 1) AS arm_angle,
           round(whiff_pct, 3) AS whiff_pct, round(csw_pct, 3) AS csw_pct, round(xwoba, 3) AS xwoba,
           round(run_value_total, 1) AS run_value,
           round(usage_pct - lag(usage_pct) OVER w, 3) AS usage_chg,
           round(avg_velo - lag(avg_velo) OVER w, 1) AS velo_chg,
           round(avg_pfx_z_in - lag(avg_pfx_z_in) OVER w, 1) AS ivb_chg,
           round(whiff_pct - lag(whiff_pct) OVER w, 3) AS whiff_chg
    FROM pitcher_season_pitch_type WHERE pitcher = ? AND pitches >= 20
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pitch_type ORDER BY season)
    ORDER BY season, pitches DESC

Q8.sql:
SELECT m.season, m.game_month, m.pitches, m.batters_faced, f.main_fb, f.main_fb_velo,
           round(m.avg_velo_fastball, 1) AS all_fb_velo, round(m.whiff_pct, 3) AS whiff_pct,
           round(m.csw_pct, 3) AS csw_pct, round(m.k_pct, 3) AS k_pct, round(m.bb_pct, 3) AS bb_pct,
           round(m.xwoba, 3) AS xwoba
    FROM pitcher_month m
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT season, game_month, any_value(pitch_type) AS main_fb, round(avg(release_speed), 1) AS main_fb_velo
               FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = ? AND pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 669373 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY season, game_month) f
           ON f.season = m.season AND f.game_month = m.game_month
    WHERE m.pitcher = ? AND (? IS NULL OR m.season = ?)
    ORDER BY m.season, m.game_month

Q11.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS period,
           min(game_date) AS first_game, max(game_date) AS last_game, 
    count(*)                                                     AS pitches,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa')))                                 AS batters_faced,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE events IN ('strikeout','strikeout_double_play'))                                  AS k,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE events IN ('walk','intent_walk'))                                 AS bb,
    CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE events IN ('strikeout','strikeout_double_play')) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))), 0)  AS k_pct,
    CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE events IN ('walk','intent_walk')) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))), 0) AS bb_pct,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 'home_run')                  AS hr,
    CAST(sum(is_whiff::INT) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(sum(is_swing::INT), 0)           AS whiff_pct,
    CAST(sum(is_chase::INT) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14), 0) AS chase_pct,
    CAST(sum(in_zone::INT) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*), 0)                      AS zone_pct,
    CAST(sum(is_csw::INT) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*), 0)                       AS csw_pct,
    avg(CASE WHEN pitch_type IN ('FF','SI','FC') THEN release_speed END)                                               AS avg_velo_fastball,
    CAST(sum(woba_value) FILTER (WHERE woba_denom = 1) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(sum(woba_denom), 0) AS woba,
    CAST(sum(CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN
        CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN coalesce(estimated_woba_using_speedangle, woba_value)
             ELSE woba_value END END) AS DOUBLE) / nullif(sum(woba_denom), 0)               AS xwoba,
    CAST(sum(babip_value) FILTER (WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run' AND babip_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS babip,
    CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE bb_type = 'fly_ball'), 0)       AS hr_per_fb,
    -sum(delta_run_exp)                                          AS run_value_total
,
           round(avg(release_speed) FILTER (WHERE pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 669373 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1)), 1) AS main_fb_velo
    FROM pitches
    WHERE pitcher = ? AND (game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE OR game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE)
    GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

    games AS (SELECT period, game_pk, avg(release_speed) AS v, count(*) AS c FROM p
              WHERE release_speed IS NOT NULL AND pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 669373 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY period, game_pk),
    s AS (SELECT stat, period, avg(v) AS mean, coalesce(var_samp(v), 0) AS variance, count(v) AS n
          FROM long GROUP BY stat, period
          UNION ALL
          
          SELECT 'main_fb_velo', period, sum(v * c) / sum(c), coalesce(var_samp(v), 0), count(*) FROM games GROUP BY period)
    SELECT a.stat, a.mean AS period_a, b.mean AS period_b, b.mean - a.mean AS change, a.n AS n_a, b.n AS n_b,
           round((b.mean - a.mean) / nullif(sqrt(a.variance / a.n + b.variance / b.n), 0), 1) AS z
    FROM s a JOIN s b ON a.stat = b.stat AND a.period = 'A' AND b.period = 'B'
    ORDER BY abs(z) DESC NULLS LAST

Q14.purpose: Skubal batted ball stats (hard hit %, exit velo, launch angle) and pitch type details in 2025 vs 2026

    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) as bbe,

SELECT season, pitch_type, pitches, round(usage_pct, 3) AS usage_pct,
           round(avg_velo, 1) AS velo, round(avg_spin) AS spin,
           round(avg_pfx_x_in, 1) AS h_break_in, round(avg_pfx_z_in, 1) AS ivb_in,
           round(avg_extension, 2) AS extension_ft, round(avg_arm_angle, 1) AS arm_angle,
           round(whiff_pct, 3) AS whiff_pct, round(csw_pct, 3) AS csw_pct, round(xwoba, 3) AS xwoba,
           round(run_value_total, 1) AS run_value,
           round(usage_pct - lag(usage_pct) OVER w, 3) AS usage_chg,
           round(avg_velo - lag(avg_velo) OVER w, 1) AS velo_chg,
           round(avg_pfx_z_in - lag(avg_pfx_z_in) OVER w, 1) AS ivb_chg,
           round(whiff_pct - lag(whiff_pct) OVER w, 3) AS whiff_chg
    FROM pitcher_season_pitch_type WHERE pitcher = ? AND pitches >= 20
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pitch_type ORDER BY season)
    ORDER BY season, pitches DESC
